svg.text: CVWT biochar bench test — rig schematic
Numbers match the equipment list (Table 3). Not to scale, except the column: ID 80 mm, bed 160 mm, taps 100 mm apart.
clear acrylic tube, ID 80 mm, length ≥ 300 mm;
5 Flow meters, at the column inlet
A: about 0.5–10 L/min B: about 5–100 L/min
open one valve at a time; reads room air
connect to the taps with equal-length tubes
two wall holes, Ø1–1.5 mm, 100 mm apart,
each 30 mm in from the bed ends;
fine mesh over each hole inside,
open it BEFORE starting the pump;
never run the pump against a closed valve
Air path: room air → flow meter → top of column → bed (downward) → control valve → dust filter → pump → exhaust
